RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. You and the successful candidate are both women; that neither proves nor rules out discrimination. Assigning a percentage would invent precision.

Focus instead on whether the ministry applied its published criteria consistently. Your qualifications are substantial, but the announcement alone cannot establish who best met those criteria.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the assessment criteria, your scores or comparative assessment where disclosable, and the reasons for selecting the successful candidate. Check local complaint deadlines without waiting for a reply. Raise panel composition only if an applicable rule requires gender balance or additional evidence makes it relevant.
